description:
Companion codegen bundle for vidocq-runtime-ravel-config-extension.
        Declare this artifact in <annotationProcessorPaths> whenever the
        application depends on the Config extension; Maven resolves the transitive
        APT dependencies below automatically.

        Runs Ravel's Build Compatible Extension (ConfigCdiExtension) inside the Vauban
        processor, so the @ConfigProperty / @ConfigProperties beans it synthesises
        exist when the processor validates the deployment. Without it, every
        @Inject @ConfigProperty point fails the compilation as an unsatisfied
        dependency (ravel#21). Configuration values are still checked when the
        container starts, where the deployment's configuration is known.

        Also runs Ravel's own processor (ravel-processor), which generates in the
        application's packages the factories of its @ConfigProperties classes and the
        implicit converters of its injected types: Ravel fills and converts them with
        plain code instead of reflection, and those packages need no opens.
